item.title: Sneako reacts to Kash Patel–Alexis Wilkins ‘honeypot’ claims amid online controversy
item.description: Online speculation about FBI Director Kash Patel and singer Alexis Wilkins' relationship has intensified after streamer Sneako dismissed the 'honeypot' conspiracy. Wilkins is suing Elijah Schaffer for defamation over his claims. Sneako suggested the relationship is normal, criticizing the sensationalism surrounding political figures' private lives and highlighting how digital creators influence public perception of news.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: “We told the truth”: Candace Owens reignites feud over Megyn Kelly’s clip of Charlie Kirk and Tucker Carlson’s Israel talk
item.description: Candace Owens has spoken out again. A video clip showed Charlie Kirk telling Tucker Carlson to speak freely on Israel. Owens stated she also spoke the truth. Megyn Kelly shared the clip from a Turning Point USA event. Kirk encouraged Carlson to express his strong views on Israel. Owens also commented on a lawsuit involving Kash Patel.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Are Kick’s streamer payouts dropping? xQc says CEO told him the rumors aren’t true
item.description: Rumors suggest Kick has reduced streamer payouts. However, popular streamer xQc has directly addressed these claims. He spoke with Kick CEO Eddie Craven, who reportedly denied any changes to the partner payout structure. xQc stated the CEO confirmed no adjustments were made. This comes amid creator concerns about declining earnings on the platform.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Police reveal shocking update in Michael Duarte’s death as influencer’s family faces heartbreak
item.description: Popular food influencer Michael Duarte, known as FoodWithBearHands, was fatally shot by police in Texas during a disturbance call involving a knife. Duarte, who amassed millions of followers for his cooking videos and charitable aspirations, was pronounced dead at a hospital. His family is seeking support to bring him home and cover funeral expenses.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: 'How many wives do you have?': Trump’s awkward exchange with Syrian president goes viral – watch
item.description: During a historic White House meeting, President Trump presented Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa with a bottle of his signature fragrance, sparking viral online attention. Trump praised Sharaa's advocacy for Middle East peace, noting the "Great Miracle" unfolding in the region and the importance of a stable Syria.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Using Epstein hoax to distract from shutdown': Trump slams Democrats; warns Republicans of 'trap'
item.description: President Trump has labelled claims linking him to Jeffrey Epstein's alleged crimes a "hoax," accusing Democrats of using the issue to distract from their own political failures and the ongoing government shutdown. Emails released by House Democrats have raised questions about Trump's past interactions with Epstein, though the White House dismisses them as a manufactured narrative.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Sneako fires back at Adin Ross and Cuffem, calls out hypocrisy in streamer culture
item.description: Streaming personality Sneako has hit back at Adin Ross and Cuffem, refuting claims of "sneak-dissing." He argues streamers face inconsistent judgment, highlighting how others make extreme jokes without backlash, while he's labeled "soft" for mentioning gambling and lean. His viral post ignited debates on accountability and hypocrisy within online entertainment.
item.dc:creator: Global Sports Desk

item.title: Marjorie Taylor Greene hits back at Trump on H-1B with 8 objections; ‘America First and America Only’
item.description: Congresswoman Marjorie Taylor Greene strongly opposed President Trump's suggestion to increase H-1B visas for skilled foreign workers, asserting her belief in American talent. She declared her firm stance against replacing American labor and criticized the admission of foreign students for financial gain.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Scott Bessent doubles down on Trump's H-1B remarks, but there's a catch: 'Come to US, train workers, then go home'
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent outlined President Trump's H-1B visa strategy, emphasizing temporary skilled worker programs for knowledge transfer to train American workers. This approach aims to rebuild the nation's industrial base and fill critical talent gaps in sectors like manufacturing and defense, rather than replacing domestic jobs.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Who is Barry Sternlicht? Billionaire who said Zohran Mamdani will turn New York City into Mumbai
item.description: Billionaire investor Barry Sternlicht warned that New York City could resemble Mumbai due to Mayor Zohran Mamdani's proposed rent-freeze and housing policies. Sternlicht, a prominent real estate figure, expressed concerns that these policies could lead to rent defaults and deter investors from the city.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Did Hasan Piker get arrested in China? The real story behind the viral Beijing livestream rumor
item.description: American streamer Hasan Piker, known as HasanAbi, was briefly questioned by Chinese security at Tiananmen Square, not arrested as social media falsely claimed. The interruption occurred after a meme featuring his face on Mao Zedong was displayed. Piker resumed his livestream, explaining it was a misunderstanding and that authorities were cautious due to foreigners rarely attending such events.
item.dc:creator: Sehjal Gupta

item.title: Why are human babies so helpless? Scientists say it’s what makes us smart
item.description: Human babies are born remarkably helpless, a deliberate evolutionary advantage. This early dependence allows for extended brain development outside the womb, fostering exceptional intelligence and adaptability. Cooperative childcare and a long childhood are crucial for learning, social bonding, and the complex problem-solving that defines our species. Embracing this slow development nurtures crucial emotional and intellectual growth.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: DHS secretary lists three must-follow rules for H-1B visas, green cards; ‘remarkables under Trump administration’
item.description: Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem affirmed the continuation of H-1B visas under the Trump administration, highlighting expedited and secure processes for immigrants. She emphasized that applicants must meet specific criteria, including not supporting terrorist groups or anti-American organizations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Pakistan passes 27th amendment: Army chief Asim Munir gains more power; to become country's first CDF
item.description: Pakistan's National Assembly has passed a significant constitutional amendment. This bill grants extensive powers to the army chief, Asim Munir, and reshapes the country's judicial system. The legislation, which received overwhelming support, aims to consolidate control over key defense and judicial institutions. It establishes a new federal constitutional court and elevates the army chief's authority over all three military branches.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: NASA explores mealworms and crickets as the next astronaut food source
item.description: NASA is exploring edible insects like mealworms and crickets for long-duration space missions to the Moon and Mars. These protein-rich creatures offer a sustainable food source, requiring minimal resources and converting waste into edible biomass. Scientists are developing methods to farm them in microgravity, aiming for self-sustaining food cycles that could revolutionize space exploration and even benefit Earth.
item.dc:creator: TOI Science Desk

item.title: Watch: Environment protestors storm into Cop30 venue in Brazil; clash with security
item.description: Indigenous and non-Indigenous protesters breached the Cop30 climate summit's Blue Zone in Belém, Brazil, leading to scuffles with security. Demonstrators demanded greater Indigenous representation and voiced concerns over funding priorities. UN security intervened, with two guards sustaining minor injuries, and an investigation is underway.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘Special relationship is dead’: UK partially halts US intel sharing after Caribbean murders
item.description: Britain has temporarily halted intelligence sharing with the US over deadly strikes on boats near Venezuela. London fears these operations may violate international law and constitute extrajudicial killings. This move, impacting maritime surveillance data, marks a significant rift, though core intelligence cooperation remains. The decision precedes a key G7 meeting, highlighting growing diplomatic tensions.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: ‘ISIS in the White House’: Laura Loomer lashes out as Donald Trump meets former militant and Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa
item.description: Far-right activist Laura Loomer criticized President Trump's White House meeting with Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa, a former militant commander. Trump praised al-Sharaa as a leader capable of rebuilding Syria, despite his past ties to a group once designated as terrorist by the US. The visit marks a historic moment, with the administration also announcing a temporary extension of sanctions relief.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Peru bus crash: Vehicle plunges 200 metres into ravine after collision with truck; 37 killed, several injured
item.description: A bus crash in Peru on Wednesday resulted in at least 37 fatalities and 24 injuries when the vehicle plunged into a 200-meter ravine after colliding with a truck. The accident occurred on the Panamericana Sur highway, with the bus traveling from Chala to Arequipa.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Row erupts over Nalin Haley saying he wants to ban H1B: 'Doesn't MAGA want this guy to be deported to India?'
item.description: Nalin Haley, son of former US Ambassador Nikki Haley, sparked controversy by advocating for a complete ban on H-1B visas. He argued the program disadvantages American graduates struggling to find employment, citing high unemployment rates among recent college graduates. Haley also called for immigrants to assimilate and support American values and workers.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk
